guide_title: ℹ️ Sɛnea wɔkenkan saa charts yi
guide_body:
• Dots / bars: boɔ a ɛsom ma afe biara ankorankoro.
  • Bold colored curve: a LOESS smoother: mpɔtam hɔ su, free to bend, enti wobɛtumi ahunu rate nsakraeɛ wɔ berɛ mu (e.g. ɔhyew a ɛkɔ ntɛmntɛm wɔ akyi ~1985).
  • Dashed line: tẽẽ a ɛyɛ den (Theil-Sen) su; ne kwan a ɛkɔ fam no yɛ “mfe du biara” akontaabu a ɛwɔ anansesɛm no mu.
  • p<0.05 / n.s.: Mann-Kendall ntease: sɛ ebia su no yɛ akontaabu mu nokware anaasɛ ebetumi ayɛ dede ara kwa (n.s. = ɛnyɛ nea ɛho hia). Mpɛn pii no, ɔhyew yɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse; osuo taa tɔ.
  • Shaded band: abakɔsɛm mu range nyinaa wɔ mfeɛ nyinaa mu ma saa bosome no.
  • Heatmap colours: temperature (blue cold → red warm); kenkan kɔla bi fi ase kɔ soro na hwɛ sɛnea saa ɔsram no sesa wɔ mfe no mu.

cap_anomalies: Afe biara sɛ wɔde toto 1961-1990 de no ho a: nnua kɔkɔɔ yɛ hyew, bruu a ɛyɛ nwini. Nsakrae a ɛba fi bruu dodow no ara so kɔ kɔkɔɔ dodow no ara so ne ɔhyew a ɛba no.
cap_heatmap: Ɔsram biara mu nkyɛmu ma afe biara sɛ kɔla grid (2 °C bands). Kenkan adum bi kɔ soro na hwɛ sɛnea saa ɔsram no yɛɛ hyew wɔ mfe du du no mu.
cap_anom_heatmap: Grid koro no ara, nanso wɔde ɔsram biara susuw n’ankasa 1961-1990 sɛnea ɛte daa no ho, enti nsakrae no nkutoo na ɛkyerɛ (kɔkɔɔ a ɛyɛ hyew sen sɛnea ɛtaa yɛ, bruu a ɛyɛ nwini), bere mu kyinhyia no fi hɔ.
cap_threshold: Nna afe biara a ɛboro 18 °C (ɔhyew) ne nea ennu 0 °C (nwini). Nneɛma abien a ɛyɛ den a ɛretwam no kyerɛ sɛ mprempren nna a ɛyɛ hyew dɔɔso sen nna a awɔw wom.

cap_volatility: Mpɛn dodow a ɔhyew a ɛkɔ soro da biara da kɛse ba afe biara (≥6 °C), ɔhyew a ɛsakrasakra
precip_annual: afe afe dodow a wɔde yɛ adwuma
cap_precip: Osu a ɛtɔ afe biara nyinaa (osu ne sukyerɛmma nsu) a ɛwɔ su bi
cap_stripes: Ntrɛwmu biara yɛ afe biako hyew: bruu yɛ nwini, kɔkɔɔ yɛ hyew sen 1961-1990 mu hyew. Nneɛma a ɛtwetwe fi bruu kɔ kɔkɔɔ no ne ɔhyew no, a biribiara nni hɔ a wɔbɛkenkan gye kɔla.
cap_season: Ɔhyew mu nyin bere tenten afe biara (nna a wɔde tu mmirika a da biara da ≥ 5 °C): mfɛnsere mu kua a awɔw nnim no gyina so, ɛkyɛ bere a wim tebea yɛ hyew no.
dtr_annual: afe afe nkyekyɛmu a ɛkɔ soro
cap_dtr: Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, nsonsonoe a ɛda da biara da biara a ɛkorɔn ne nea ɛba fam ntam. Ɔkwan a ɛso tew yɛ nsateaa a wɔde kyerɛ sɛnea wim yɛ hyew: anadwo a ɛyɛ hyew ntɛmntɛm sen nna; nea ɛtrɛw betumi akyerɛ sɛ ɛreyow.
seasonshift_title: Sɛnea mmere mu kyinhyia no sesae, {name}.
seasonshift_ylabel: Ɔsram biara ɔhyew a ɛkɔ soro (°C).
cap_seasonshift: Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, afe a edi kan vs. mfe du a etwa to a kyerɛwtohɔ. Nsonsonoe a ɛda nkuruwankuruwa no ntam wɔ ɔsram biara mu no kyerɛ afe no afã horow a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew kɛse (mpɛn pii no awɔw bere sen ahohuru bere).
health_sub: Sɛnea ɔhyew a ɛrekɔ so wɔ atifi hɔ no kyerɛ ase kɔ ɔhyew, awɔw ne nsɛm a esisi a ɛtra so ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wogye tom mu. Chart biara pue wɔ baabi a data a ehia no wɔ.
cap_degreedays: Afe afe ɔhyew-awerɛkyekye adesoa: ɔhyew ahiade (a ɛba fam 18 °C) kɔ fam bere a onwini ahiade (boro 22 °C) kɔ soro, ananmusifo ma awɔw a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu ne mframa a wɔde yɛ adwuma a wɔhwehwɛ.
cap_heatwave: Nna a ɛwɔ ɔhyew asorɔkye mu: mmirikatu a ɛyɛ ≥nnafua 3 a da biara da dodow boro mpɔtam hɔ 1961-1990 ɔha biara mu nkyem 90 so. Awiabere mu ɔhyew a ɛkɔ so daa ne ade titiriw a ɛma ɔhyew asorɔkye wuwu boro so.
tropic_title: Anadwo a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew afe biara, {name}.
cap_tropic: Anadwo a nea ɛba fam no tra 20 °C anaasɛ ɛboro saa, enti nipadua no nnya ahotɔ biara anadwo biako, ade a edi kan a wɔtaa bu ani gu so a ɛde owu a efi ɔhyew mu ba.
coldspell_title: Nna a awɔw wom afe biara, {name}.
coldspell_ylabel: Nna a awɔw wom afe biara
cap_coldspell: Nna wɔ awɔw bere mu: mmirikatu a ɛyɛ ≥nnafua 3 a da biara da nea ɛba fam no sua sen mpɔtam hɔ 1961-1990 ɔha biara mu nkyem 10. Awɔw bere tenten ma nnipa wuwu wɔ awɔw bere mu wɔ koma ne ɔhome mu boro so.
heavyrain_title: Nna a osu tɔ kɛse afe biara, {name}.
cap_heavyrain: Nna a anyɛ yiye koraa no osu tɔ mm 20 (ETCCDI R20mm), osu a ɛtɔ kɛse a ɛde nsuyiri ba a ɛde opira, tu a wotu fi wɔn afie mu ne nyarewa a efi nsu mu ba.
heatindex_title: Ɔhyew-index nna a asiane wom afe biara, {name}.
cap_heatindex: Nna a ɛda adi sɛ ɔhyew (ɔhyew index, a ɛbobɔw wɔ ɔhyew mu) du ɔhyew-adwennwen dodow, metric ɔmanfo ɔhyew afotufo de di dwuma. Hia dataset a ɛda adi sɛ ɛyɛ hyew.
